claims.full_proposition: For the declared two-population, two-indicator conditional-independent law, fixing the statistical latent Z and every observable distribution does not constrain the kernel P(H_way|Z). The identical observable tables admit H_way=Z, H_way independent of Z, and H_way=1-Z, yielding positive, zero, and negative indicator contrasts relative to H_way.
claims.domain: The specified binary no-gold-standard indicator model; more generally, evidence laws that factor through Z and omit P(H_way|Z).
premises: the indicator likelihood is specified conditional on Z
H_way is not definitionally equated with Z
no independent target-identity observation is added
claims.proof: Hold P(Z), P(T1|Z), and P(T2|Z) fixed, append each of three exact kernels P(H_way|Z), and marginalize. H_way is absent from the observable likelihood, so both population tables remain invariant while exact indicator contrasts relative to H_way are positive, zero, and negative.
claims.counterexamples_and_limits: An independently target-directed intervention, phenomenological contrast, or causal measurement bridge may constrain P(H_way|Z); the result does not rule out those evidence classes.

claims.full_proposition: A3X content admissibility, latent-class recovery, R202 endpoint inversion, and R203 covariance direction support an H_way-level claim only when an independently warranted target-identity bridge makes the calibrated endpoint about H_way; statistical agreement cannot supply that identity bridge by itself.
premises: A3X S_H is not truth calibration
R202 requires independently calibrated a and c
R203 requires independently warranted endpoint direction and residual bound
claims.support: Cross-round type audit and exact A3Y witness.
claims.counterexamples_and_limits: A future defensible target-identity bridge could satisfy the missing premise; A3Y does not show none exists.

claims.full_proposition: Failure to identify a statistical latent Z with a named H_way value blocks empirical semantic naming but does not negate the conditional C1 transport of independently grounded actual organization to experience-internal structure; semantic measurement and actual same-instance admission remain separate obligations.
claims.domain: UCT C1/R157/R173 interpretation with no new formal-map rule.
premises: no inference from model fit to actual installation
claims.support: Inherited formal claims plus A3Y's typed distinction; this is a synthesis/correction, not a new theorem.
claims.counterexamples_and_limits: C1 alone does not select the English label familiar mineness or prove that a proposed route is actual.

claims.full_proposition: Without a preregistered phenomenal-target identity bridge and an unfitted defeat condition, a no-gold-standard fit must be reported as a result about latent Z or judgement structure, not as evidence about H_way, and the H_way route-comparison stage must not begin.
premises: target and proxy are separately typed
route comparison would otherwise inherit an unnamed latent target
claims.support: Logical stopping consequence of nonidentification and the existing review requirements.
claims.counterexamples_and_limits: It does not prohibit exploratory Z-level analyses or organizational tests that make no H_way attribution.
